text: Residents on Triller Avenue between Queen Street West and King Street West are requesting that the current on-street parking moves from the west side of the street to the east side of the street to gain more parking spots. There are currently 4 consecutive accessible on-street parking spaces on the west side of the street that will be moved to other side as well. A petition showing support for the change was shared with my office and Transportation Staff.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing parking by permit regulation in effect from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. daily on the even (west) side of Triller Avenue from King Street West to Harvard Avenue to be in effect from 12:01 a.m. to 7:01 a.m. daily on the even (west) side of Triller Avenue from Queen Street West to Harvard Avenue. 2. Prohibited parking at all times on the west side of Triller Avenue between King Street West and a point 154 metres north 3. Prohibited stopping at all times on the west side of Triller Avenue between Queen Street West and a point 9 metres south 4. Authorized parking by permit only from 12:01 a.m. to 7:00 a.m. daily on the odd (east) side of Triller Avenue between Queen Street West and King Street West. 5. Authorized the removal/installation of on-street accessible parking spaces at the locations identified in Attachment 1 attached…
